title: LOG_VERSION 5→6 bump has no dedicated old-version rejection test (placement's 2→3 precedent unfollowed)
evidence:
core/serialize.odin:491: `LOG_VERSION :: u32(6)        // 6.3: Cmd_Set_Pipe_Tier joins the command set (was 5: Cmd_Era_Advance)`. The 6.3 wire test (test_modernize_log_round_trip, core/legacy_test.odin:224) only round-trips a CURRENT log: `log := log_write(&s, context.temp_allocator, s.era)
	h, cmds, ok := log_read(log, context.temp_allocator)
	testing.expect(t, ok, "the modernize log must parse")`. The only version-rejection pin is generic — core/determinism_test.odin:468-474: `fut[4] = 99 // bump the version field (second u32, little-endian)
	fut[5], fut[6], fut[7] = 0, 0, 0
	_, _, future := log_read(fut, context.temp_allocator)
	testing.expect(t, !future, "unknown version must reject")`. The project's own bump precedent does more — core/placement_test.odin:412-420: `// a version-2 log must reject cleanly (LOG_VERSION 3 — the 1.2→2 precedent:
	// old logs are a defined rejection, never a silent partial parse)
	v2 := make([]u8, len(bytes), context.temp_allocator)
	copy(v2, bytes)
	v2[4] = 2 // version field (second u32, little-endian)` … `testing.expect(t, !old, "a version-2 log must reject cleanly (LOG_VERSION 3)")`. No equivalent v5 leg exists in legacy_test.odin or era_test.odin.
detail: The 5→6 old-log rejection is covered only by the generic unknown-version pin; the codebase's own per-bump precedent (dedicated old-version test) wasn't followed for 6.3.
recommended_fix: Add a leg to test_modernize_log_round_trip: clone the written log, set the version field to 5, expect log_read to reject (mirroring placement_test's v2 leg).

title: Golden pair's twin property (identical seed/topology/demand, one modernize) is prose-only — no machine check pins it
evidence:
The twin property exists only as a demo comment — demos/legacy_modernized.dem:2-3: `# the decayed-vs-modernized throughput pair. Identical to legacy_decay.dem
# (same seed, topology, demand, gate): era 2 all-standard, the gate fires` with the sole delta at line 22: `at 30000ms modernize 0 wide`. The harness verifies each demo independently — harness/run.odin:542/549: `check_manifest(name, &demo, cat.hash, hz, hashes[:], &fails)` / `} else if !verify_replay(name, &cfg, hashes[:]) {` — no cross-demo comparison anywhere in harness/. Verified manually this round via the stats streams: P rows identical through tick 599/600 (`P,600,0,1,7,0,0` in both), modernize flips tier/cap at tick 601 (`P,601,0,2,40,30,30` modernized vs `P,601,0,1,7,30,30` decayed), end-state `C,1400,1,851,172,671,79` (decay, 671 dropped) vs `C,1400,1,851,846,0,0` (modernized, 0 dropped).
detail: Contrast validity depends on the twins differing only by modernize; the harness checks each demo against its own manifest, never the pair. Twin-ness verified manually this round only.
recommended_fix: Add a pair-consistency gate to drift-check or ci-local: byte-compare the two demos' stats streams through the divergence tick (600), or diff the .dem texts modulo modernize lines.

Headers byte-verified: both goldens/legacy_{decay,modernized}.t1 carry `seed 20261` + `catalog_hash 733a64aef127178c` + `ticks 1400`; both .log.bin are LOG_VERSION 6 with command counts 4 vs 8 (draws + modernizes). Behavior traced to core/legacy_test.odin's 9 @(test) contracts incl. test_legacy_decayed_vs_modernized_throughput (delivered 20 vs shed) and test_modernize_replay_identity.
